text: Please introduce yourself briefly.
Can you confirm the course and the university you have applied to, and when it starts?
Tell me about your previous qualification and why you chose that subject.
How does your previous study connect with the course you want to study now?
What have you been doing since you finished your last qualification?
How will your work experience help you in this course?
Why do you want to study in the UK rather than in Nepal?
Did you consider Australia, Canada or the USA? Why did you choose the UK instead?
Why did you choose {{university}}?
What do you know about {{city}}, where you will be living?
Which modules will you study on this course, and which one interests you most?
How is this course assessed? Exams, coursework or both?
This course is at the same level as your previous qualification. Why do you need it?
How will you pay your tuition fees and your living costs?
Who is your sponsor, what do they do, and roughly what do they earn?
What do you think your monthly living costs in the UK will be?
Where do you plan to live, and how will you travel to campus?
Have you applied for a visa to any country before? Have you ever been refused?
What do you plan to do after you complete this course?
How will this qualification help you specifically, back in Nepal?
Tell me about a challenge you faced recently and how you handled it.
Is there anything else you would like to add before we finish?
What do you do at the moment — are you working or studying?
What grades did you get in your last qualification, and which subjects did you do best in?
Where did you complete your schooling and your last qualification, and under which board or university?
Have you studied outside your home country before?
What did you learn in your time away from study that will help you on this course?
Why did you not continue your studies immediately after your last qualification?
What do you know about studying and living in the UK?
Studying in the UK costs much more than studying at home. Why is it worth it for you?
Why are you applying for this intake rather than an earlier or a later one?
What challenges do you expect as an international student, and how will you deal with them?
How did you first find out about {{university}}?
Which other universities did you apply to, and what offers did you receive?
Do you know anyone who has studied at {{university}} or who lives in the UK?
How big is {{university}}, and what kind of university is it?
What support does {{university}} offer international students?
Why {{university}}, when other universities offer the same course?
How is your course structured — what happens in each semester or term?
How long is your course, and what exact qualification will you hold when you finish?
Does your course carry any professional recognition, accreditation or placement?
Which other courses did you consider before choosing this one?
What were the entry requirements for your course, and how did you meet them?
What will you do if the course turns out to be harder than you expected?
What do you already know about the subject you are about to study?
How is this course a clear step up from what you have already studied?
How much are your tuition fees, and how much have you already paid?
Can you pay your tuition fees in full, and when is the rest of the money due?
Besides your main sponsor, do you have any other funding — savings, scholarships, or family support?
Do you know how much money you must show for living costs, and is it ready?
Will you have access to this money for your whole time in the UK? Whose name is the account in?
How will your family manage their own living costs while also paying for your studies?
Have you checked the refund policy — what happens to your money if your visa is refused?
Do you plan to work part-time in the UK, and does your budget depend on it?
Who decided the budget for your studies, and how was the decision made at home?
What research have you done on accommodation — what did you compare, and what will it cost?
Will you live on campus or off campus, and why?
What do you know about the cost of living in {{city}} compared with other UK cities?
Who will you live with in the UK, and do you have relatives there?
This will be your first time living alone. How will you manage daily life — cooking, laundry, budgeting?
What are the conditions of a UK Student visa — what are you allowed and not allowed to do?
Have you ever travelled abroad before — for study, work or a visit?
Do you know what happens to your visa if you stop attending or fail your course?
Are you planning to transfer to a different university after you arrive in the UK?
Did you use an education consultancy or agent, and what did they help you with?
Are you planning to stay in the UK after your course finishes?
What will you do if your visa application is refused?
Where do you see yourself five years from now?
Are you planning further study after this course, or is this the final qualification you need?
What will you do if you cannot find a job in your field straight after graduating?
Tell me about your home town and what you like about it.
What do you enjoy doing outside your studies and work?
Did you have any failed subjects, backlogs or repeated years in your previous studies?
Why should you be granted a student visa? What makes you a genuine student?
Who is your course leader or programme director, and have you looked at who teaches your course?
How many credits does your course carry, and roughly how are they spread across modules?
Does your course offer optional modules? Which ones do you plan to choose, and why?
Which campus will your course be taught on, and what do you know about it?
How is teaching at a UK university different from how you studied in Nepal, and how will you adjust?
Do you have any personal savings of your own, separate from your sponsor?
If you have a scholarship or discount, what exactly does it cover — and what do you still pay yourselves?
You have planned for the first year. How will you cover the second year, or the rest of your course?
What happens to your studies if your sponsor’s circumstances change — a bad year in the business, or a job loss?
How will you manage unexpected costs — an emergency trip home, a medical need, a laptop that dies?
What documents will you show to prove your funding — and have you read them yourself?
What is the weather like in {{city}} for most of the year, and what does an ordinary meal cost there?
What is your weekly budget in the UK, and how did you arrive at that number?
Will any dependants — a spouse or children — travel with you or join you in the UK later?
Tell me about your family’s immigration history. Has anyone applied to live, work or study abroad?
Have you ever overstayed a visa, or broken the conditions of one, in any country?
Do you or your immediate family have any pending immigration or residency applications in another country?
What ties do you have at home in Nepal — family, property, work — that will bring you back?
Salaries in the UK are much higher than in Nepal. Why would you actually come back?
What research have you done into the job market this course leads to?
What was the most interesting topic in the subject you studied most recently?
Tell me about a recent book, news story or topic that interested you.
Tell me about a typical day in your life at the moment.
Why not study this course in your home country?
Which other countries did you consider, and what made you decide on the UK?
Which other universities did you consider?
What facilities are you expecting at {{university}} for your subject?
What will you actually learn in the modules you just named?
Do you know what level your course is at?
Where did the money in that bank account come from?
What does your sponsor do, and how many people depend on that income?
Have you taken a loan? How will you pay it back?
How far is that from campus, and how will you get to class?
How much will your accommodation cost each week?
Why is there such a long gap between your last course and this one?
What was your monthly salary in that job?
Have you studied in the UK before? Why are you studying here again?
What jobs could you actually do after this course?
What salary do you expect when you go home?
Do you know how many hours you are allowed to work during term time?
Have you made any previous visa applications? Were they successful?
How long have those funds been in the account?
Are those funds still in the account today?
Your statement shows a large deposit shortly before the application. Where did that come from?
You said your sponsor is not your parent. When did you last meet them, and why are they funding you?
How does that rent fit inside the monthly budget you described?
Where did that accommodation figure come from — which website, page or person?
You had offers from other universities. Why did you turn those down?
Leave the module names aside — explain to me in your own words what your course is actually about.
Your new course is quite different from what you studied before. Why the change of field?
What will your spouse do while you are studying in the UK?
You mentioned a previous visa. Did you comply fully with its conditions?
You said you will return to Nepal to work. Which companies or organisations would you actually apply to?
During that gap, was it work, exam preparation, or family responsibility — walk me through it.
Tell me about yourself: where you are from, what you have studied, and what you are doing now.
What is your current occupation, and how long have you been doing it?
What was the last course you completed, and when did you finish it?
Tell me about your family. Who do you live with, and what do they do?
Which English test did you take, what score did you get, and which part was hardest for you?
Do you know why this interview is taking place, and what we are trying to find out?
How did you prepare for this interview?
What was your final percentage or GPA, and how does it compare with what {{university}} asked for?
If you have studied in the UK before, did you complete that course, and how much of your Student visa time limit have you used?
Does anyone in your family have a degree, or has anyone studied overseas before you?
Describe one project or assignment from your previous studies that prepared you for this course.
Why are you returning to study now, rather than two years ago or two years from now?
After a break from study, what makes you confident you can cope with full-time academic work again?
Between finishing your last course and today, which months were you not working and not studying, and what were you doing then?
What is different about how a UK university teaches, and why does that suit you?
Walk me through how you decided on the UK. What did you compare, and who did you talk to?
Could you have studied this subject in Nepal? What would you miss by studying at home?
What did you find out about {{university}} that you could not have said about any other university?
Where exactly is {{university}}, and how would you get there from the airport on your first day?
Have you spoken to any current students or graduates of {{university}}? What did they tell you?
Who first suggested {{university}} to you, and what did you check for yourself before accepting the offer?
Which service or facility at {{university}} will you actually use in your first term, and why?
Name three core modules of your course, and explain what one of them actually covers.
What first made you interested in this subject, and when did you decide to study it at this level?
You could study this subject at many universities. What is different about the version of the course at {{university}}?
What can you do today, and what will you be able to do after this course that you cannot do now?
You already hold a qualification at this level. What does a second one add that your first did not?
Why are you not continuing in the field you studied before?
For a student at {{university}}, how much does UKVI say you must show for living costs, and for how many months?
Have you paid a tuition deposit? How much, when, and from which account did it go?
How did your sponsor build up the money for your studies, and over how long?
If you have an education loan, which bank is it from, how much is sanctioned, and has it been paid out yet?
Does anyone other than your family contribute: a scholarship, an employer, a government scheme? What exactly does it cover?
If you work part-time in the UK, what would you realistically earn, and does your plan depend on it?
Have you already arranged your accommodation, or when and how will you do it?
Apart from the university, why {{city}}? What do you know about living there as a student?
What happens in your first week in the UK? Where will you sleep on night one, and what will you sort out first?
What will you find hardest about daily life in {{city}} compared with home, and what have you done to prepare for it?
Do you know what the Graduate visa is, and are you planning to use it?
Have you ever been to the UK before, even as a visitor? When, and for what purpose?
Do you have close relatives living outside Nepal, in the UK or anywhere else? Where, and what is their status?
What are three things you are required to do, or not allowed to do, while on a Student visa?
What job title will you apply for when you go back to Nepal, and what is a realistic starting salary for it?
Is there a specific job, business or responsibility waiting for you in Nepal when you finish?
If you were offered a good job in the UK after graduating, what would you do?
After this course, is your next step a job or more study? If more study, where, and who would pay?
Name two employers in Nepal who hire people with this qualification, and what they would hire you to do.
How will you spend your semester breaks and your free time in the UK?
Describe a time you had to manage on your own without your family. What did you learn from it?
Some people would say you should be settling into a career at your age, not starting a course. What would you say to them?
You mentioned a land sale. When was it registered, and where is the sale document?
What is your sponsor's income after their own household costs, and is that enough for your second year?
If we rang your sponsor's bank today, would they confirm the balance on the statement you submitted?
Your loan repayment starts after the course. How much is it a month, and how does that fit the salary you expect?
You named a module. What is one assignment or exam you will have to pass in it?
Who teaches that module, or what research is the department known for?
You said you will live off campus. Which bus or train would you take, and how much would that cost a month?
If that hall is full when you apply, what is your second option and what does it cost?
You mentioned a refusal. What reason did the refusal letter give, and what has changed since then?
You mentioned family who might join you. Do you know who is allowed to bring dependants on a Student visa now?
You mentioned a backlog. How many attempts did it take, and what did you do differently the last time?
Which specific part of your old degree will you actually use on this course?
What documents could you show for that time, such as an employment letter, a pay slip or an exam registration?
At that salary, how much of your own savings did you manage to put towards this course?
What was the total cost of the option you rejected, compared with this one?
You mentioned the UK education system. What is one rule or feature of it you only learned during your research?
What did the university you rejected offer that {{university}} does not?
How far is the campus from the city centre of {{city}}, and what is around it?
You named an employer. What would they need to see from you, beyond the degree, to hire you?
What is the exact month your visa ends, and what will you be doing in the month after that?
Who in Nepal is counting on you to come back, and what happens to them if you do not?
Explain that same answer again in different words, as if I had not understood you.
Why did you choose this course, and how does it relate to what you studied before?
What facilities does {{university}} have for your course?
Which modules will you study in your first semester, and which ones come later?
How will you handle the cultural differences you will meet in the UK?
What excites you most about studying at {{university}}?
Can you name any rankings, achievements or special features of {{university}}?
What is your biggest dream in life, and how does this course fit into it?
How will you balance your studies, your social life and any part-time work in the UK?
Imagine it is your first week at {{university}}. What is the first thing you will do after your classes finish?
How will you deal with loneliness, homesickness or stress during your time in the UK?
